# StemplerInd

> StemplerInd is a free Danish time tracking app for employees and freelancers. You clock in and out with one tap, an NFC tag, a shortcut or a widget. The app adds up all ins and outs per day and keeps track of target hours, balance (flextime), absence, public holidays and projects. All data stays on the device: no account, no ads, no tracking. The business sells physical NFC tags in packs.

## Facts

- App: free. Android app (Google Play: not published yet), web app at https://stemplerind.dk/app/ that can be installed on the home screen. iPhone app: not available yet.
- Languages: Danish, English, Swedish, Norwegian and German.
- Public holidays for Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Germany.
- Absence: sick days, holidays, child's sick day, time off in lieu, parental leave and custom types.
- Projects: coloured or symbol NFC tags move time to a project. Users name the projects themselves in the app.
- Warnings about forgotten clock-outs, long days, weekend work and many ins and outs.
- Approve a period and export to Excel, Word or PDF.
- Privacy: everything is stored on the phone. The employer cannot see the data unless the user exports and shares it.
- NFC tags: round, 30 mm, NTAG213, written and locked. They contain only a web address such as https://stemplerind.dk/t/skift and the app id dk.stemplerind.app. No personal data. The same tag works for every user.

## NFC tag packs

Prices in Danish kroner (DKK) including 25 % Danish VAT.

- Startpakken (Starter pack): 5 tags, DKK 249. Everything you need to clock in and out and report absence.
- Projektpakken (Project pack): 6 tags, DKK 299. Six coloured tags for projects, clients or work areas. You decide what each colour means.
- Talpakken (Number pack): 6 tags, DKK 299. Six black project tags with the numbers 1 to 6. Easy to keep track of, and no text.
- Symbolpakken (Symbol pack): 6 tags, DKK 299. Six white project tags with black symbols. Calm to look at, and no text.
- Hele suiten (Full set): 24 tags, DKK 745. The starter pack, parental leave and all 18 project tags: colours, numbers and symbols. For when you want everything covered.
- Ind og ud-mærke (Clock in and out tag): 1 tag, DKK 75. Other tags are only sold in packs.
- Eget design (Custom design): tags with the customer's own logo or symbols, from DKK 1,549. Ordered through the contact form.

Full set costs DKK 401 less than the other three packs bought separately (DKK 1,146).

## How the tags work

- Clock in and out tag: first scan clocks in, next scan clocks out.
- Sick tag: first scan reports sick and clocks out, next scan reports well again.
- Holiday and parental leave tags: first scan starts, next scan ends.
- Project tags: move the time to a project. Scanning the same tag again returns to normal time.
